content_text: People don’t spend enough time reward hacking their own brain. What’s impressive about people like Tyler Cowen isn’t his intellect it’s how he managed to figure out how to keep himself consistently curious without burnout. The return on being highly introspective around what forms of content and learning stimulate dopamine and which don’t is very very high.
